title: [HONEY BADGER]
who: The world cast him out and then wouldn't leave him there. Born albino, left in the den on his first day; a mamba's venom, a lion's jaws and a pack's grave each left a scar in him; he went out past the edge to be alone, and the legend of him keeps bringing challengers, none of whom has left. The herds' name for him is a warning, not a title.
